universities.name: Anhui University of Technology
universities.overview:
Anhui University of Technology (AHUT) is located in Ma’anshan, Anhui, China. Its international study routes bring together business, engineering and science, with English-taught degrees in international trade, metallurgy, materials, chemistry and environmental science.

For students from Bangladesh, the right starting point is the degree and teaching language. Compare the course duration, entry qualifications and scholarship conditions, then plan tuition, accommodation and other required costs together. Chinese language study is also listed separately from the degree routes.

highlights.title: Business and research degrees
highlights.description: International economics and trade at bachelor’s level, international trade at master’s level, and research routes in engineering and science.

highlights.title: English and Chinese study routes
highlights.description: English-taught degrees and Chinese language courses have their own tuition periods and admission requirements.

programs.name: International Economics and Trade
qualifications: Non-Chinese citizen; valid passport; good health.
High-school qualification. Under-18 applicants need a guardian guarantee in China.
languageRequirements: IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL iBT 70 or accepted equivalent; university testing may apply.

documents: Passport and digital photo.
Notarized highest qualification and transcripts.
Physical examination form and blood-test report.
English proficiency certificate or official medium-of-instruction evidence.
Bank statement: CNY 30,000 or USD 5,000; validity six months.
Notarized Chinese or English translations where needed.

conversionResearch.note: Rechecked official degree and fee evidence for the conversion redesign. No separate official international 2027 offer was established. A domestic graduate-school notice is not international admission evidence. Campus-image downloads timed out and were not published.

searchPublication.rationale: Owner authorized researched evergreen guides to be indexed separately from admission availability. Institution, programme levels, tuition, qualifications, documents and award values are supported by university materials. This publishes an informational guide; historical admission cycles and original evidence remain internal, and planned programme/closed award statuses are preserved. No 2027 opening or institutional partnership is asserted.
